newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end lower, but further gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end lower, but further gains seen.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed slightly lower on Friday, consolidating recent gains, dealers said.
The market is firmly underpinned, with nine-month corporate earnings providing a focus, they said.
The general index fell 0.61 points, 0.16 percent, to 382.80 and the Ibex fell 9.74 points, 0.22 percent, to 4,396.91.
Repsol fell 60 pesetas, in line with European oil stocks.
Santander rose 30 pesetas, off an intraday high. IBCA affirmed its credit ratings after news of the Invermexico deal.
Electricity firm Endesa shed 80 pesetas to 7,979 as dealers weighed the implications of its Sevillana and Fecsa buys.
"Despite the fall there's interest in the market and some companies are attracting buyers," said one trader.
Telefonica in particular gave the market strength, with interest high ahead of next year's placement.
The fact that volume was lower when sellers came out was a cause of some optimism, he added.
Turnover was modest at around 36 billion pesetas. RTR LOL
